cases.question: What are the entrance requirements for the Computer Information Technology diploma at BCIT?
cases.standalone_question: What are the entrance requirements for the Computer Information Technology diploma at BCIT?
cases.answer_excerpt:
To be eligible for the full-time Computer Information Technology (CIT) diploma, you must meet the following entrance requirements:

*   **English Language Proficiency:** Category 2 – English Studies 12 (67%) or an equivalent.
*   **Mathematics:** One of the following:
    *   Pre-Calculus 12 (67%)
    *   Foundations of Math 12 (73%)
    *   Other acceptable BC and Yukon courses.

Applicants are accepted on a first-qualified basis as long as space remains in the program. You must provide proof of meeting these requirements when you submit your application.

If you have previously completed equivalent courses at BCIT or another institution, you may be eligible for transfer credit, provided you earned a minimum grade of 60% and completed the coursework within the last five years. You can apply for this after being accepted into the program by submitting a Course Credit Exemption form.

For further details on meeting these requirements or information regarding the application process, you can visit the official BCIT website.

Sources:
https://www.bcit.ca/programs/computer-information-technology-diploma-full-time-5540dipma/

*   **Official Transcripts Required:** You must have your official transcripts sent directly to BCIT from the institution(s) you previously attended.

cases.question: BCIT 간호 프로그램 입학하려면 뭐가 필요해?
cases.standalone_question: BCIT 간호 프로그램 입학하려면 뭐가 필요해?
cases.answer_excerpt:
BCIT의 간호 전문 프로그램(Specialty Nursing)에 입학하기 위해 필요한 주요 요건은 다음과 같습니다.

*   **학력:** 간호학 학위(Diploma in Nursing)가 필요합니다.
*   **등록 자격:** BC 간호사 및 조산사 협회(BCCNM) 또는 캐나다 내 동등한 기관에 등록된 현직 간호사여야 합니다. 해외에서 실무 중인 경우 RN 면허 번호가 필요합니다.
*   **영어 능력:** Category 1 기준을 충족해야 하며, 이는 English Studies 12(73%) 또는 그에 상응하는 성적을 의미합니다.
*   **경력:** 급성기 치료(acute care) 환경에서 최소 6개월 이상의 실무 경력이 필요하며, 지원 시 이력서를 제출해야 합니다. 최근 2년 이내의 급성기 경력이 없는 경우 보수 교육(refresher course)이 요구될 수 있습니다.

**임상 실습을 위한 추가 요구 사항:**
임상 과정에 참여하기 위해서는 다음 사항들이 필수적입니다.
*   **예방 접종:** 인플루엔자 백신 접종 증명서가 필요하며, 미접종 시 임상 실습 중 마스크를 상시 착용해야 합니다.
*   **CPR:** 캐나다 기관에서 발급한 실습 포함 과정인 CPR Level C 또는 HCP 자격증이 필요합니다.
*   **호흡기 적합성 테스트(Fit Testing):** 임상 실습 전 N95 마스크(1860, 1860s, 또는 1870 모델)에 대한 적합성 테스트를 완료하고 인증서를 소지해야 합니다.
*   **등록 유지:** 임상 과정 중에는 항상 BCCNM 회원 자격 또는 RN 면허를 유지해야 합니다.

국제 지원자의 경우, 캐나다 외부에서 프로그램을 이수하거나 캐나다 내 유효한 취업 허가증(work permit)을 소지하고 있어야 합니다. 이 프로그램은 학생 비자(study permit) 발급 대상이 아닙니다.

구체적인 자격 요건이나 경력 인정 여부에 대해서는 각 프로그램 담당자(program head)에게 문의하시기 바랍니다.

cases.standalone_question: How many business days after the start of class do I have to withdraw from a BCIT full-time program to get a refund?

prior_turns.question: Tell me about BCIT's refund policy for full-time programs.

cases.answer_excerpt:
For most full-time programs, you must voluntarily withdraw within **10 business days** after the start of class to be eligible for a tuition refund.

Please note the following details regarding this deadline:
*   **Commitment Fees:** These are non-refundable regardless of when you withdraw.
*   **Ineligibility:** If you are required to withdraw due to disciplinary reasons or unsatisfactory progress after this 10-day deadline, you will not be eligible for a refund.
*   **U-Pass BC:** These fees are collected on behalf of Translink and are not covered by BCIT’s refund policy.

If you are a student in a Flexible Learning (part-time) course, refund deadlines vary based on the course length and delivery method (e.g., classroom-based vs. distance learning). You should check the specific refund requirements provided when you registered for your course.

Sources:
- https://www.bcit.ca/admission/tuition-fees/refunds-withdrawals/

cases.question: Tell me about the Biomedical Engineering Technology diploma.
cases.follow_up: Do I need chemistry to get in?
cases.standalone_question: Are there chemistry course requirements for admission to the BCIT Biomedical Engineering Technology diploma program?

prior_turns.question: Tell me about the Biomedical Engineering Technology diploma.

cases.answer_excerpt:
Yes, you are required to have chemistry to be admitted into the Biomedical Engineering Technology diploma program.

To meet the entrance requirements, you must provide proof of one of the following (or an equivalent):

*   Chemistry 11 (67%)
*   Chemistry 12 (67%)
*   CHEM 0110 – Chemistry 11 Challenge Exam – BCIT (67%)
*   CHEM 0120 – Chemistry 12 Challenge Exam – BCIT (67%)
*   3.0 credits of post-secondary chemistry (67%) from a recognized institution

Sources:
- https://www.bcit.ca/programs/biomedical-engineering-technology-diploma-full-time-5063dipma/
